slides.label: Executive summary
slides.descriptor: Appoint C&W as your single point of control — you decide, we deliver
slides.situation: Corum owns Westgate I — a prime 27,000 m² Amsterdam office, fully let to PwC — and has committed to make the building Paris Proof: a binding contractual obligation, not an ambition.
slides.complication: The upgrade must happen inside a live, occupied building without losing PwC's confidence, on a fixed budget and against a hard deadline — steered from a distance by an investor, not a builder.
slides.question: How does Corum deliver Paris Proof and protect the PwC tenancy and the asset's value — without being pulled into day-to-day management in the Netherlands?
slides.answer: Appoint Cushman & Wakefield as your single point of control. We deliver the transformation end-to-end and keep PwC fully aware and aligned — from a low-commitment preparatory phase to verified handover. One contact, one report, no surprises.

slides.label: Contents
items: WHAT WE TAKE OFF YOUR PLATE

slides.label: 01 — The case for action · Complication
slides.descriptor: Three forces converge on one occupied building — and all three touch your return

cards.title: 01 THE TENANT RISK
cards.body: PwC keeps working while you rebuild. Poor communication erodes trust — and puts renewal, income and exit value at risk.

cards.title: 02 THE DELIVERY RISK
cards.body: Fixed budget, complex technique, live site. Every sequencing or technical mistake is visible to the tenant and expensive to the owner.

cards.title: 03 THE DEADLINE RISK
cards.body: Paris Proof is contractual, not optional. Slippage is breach exposure. The critical path must be owned from day one.

slides.strap: Left unmanaged, these risks compound. Managed by one accountable party, they become a controlled programme.

slides.statement:
Make Cushman & Wakefield your single
point of control in the Netherlands.
slides.body: We deliver the entire Paris Proof transformation end-to-end and keep PwC fully aware and aligned at every step. You steer the asset; we run the works and the tenant relationship.

slides.label: 02 — What we take off your plate · Deep dive 1
slides.descriptor: We deliver the works with PwC fully aware and aligned

cards.title: ONE FAMILIAR INTERFACE
cards.body: The Stakeholder Management PM owns the PwC relationship end-to-end — one consistent point of contact.

cards.title: ACTIVELY INVOLVED IN DECISIONS
cards.body: PwC is actively involved in the decision-making process — briefed early, aligned before we act.

cards.title: CONTINUOUS INSIGHT & TIMELY NOTICE
cards.body: Continuous insight into progress and planning; timely communication of any change that impacts operations.

cards.title: FULL CONFIDENCE, PROTECTED VALUE
cards.body: PwC experiences full confidence that the project is under control. A confident tenant renews.

slides.left: One concise monthly report answers four questions — Are we on schedule? On budget? Is PwC satisfied? What decisions do you need to take next? Detail lives in the appendix; decisions arrive prepared.
